author: Joyce Ramirez
title: Bellecapital International Ltd. Sells 16,615 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Posted by Joyce Ramirez on Jan 17th, 2018 // No Comments 
Bellecapital International Ltd. reduced its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 40.7% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 24,255 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 16,615 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 4.4% of Bellecapital International Ltd.’s portfolio, making the stock its 6th biggest holding. Bellecapital International Ltd.’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,738,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Gareth Morgan Investments Limited Partnership grew its holdings in shares of Apple by 43.8% in the first quarter. Gareth Morgan Investments Limited Partnership now owns 197,228 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $28,334,000 after purchasing an additional 60,041 shares during the period. Harbour Capital Advisors LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter valued at about $4,591,000. Macquarie Group Ltd. grew its holdings in shares of Apple by 12.0% in the first quarter. Macquarie Group Ltd. now owns 1,147,427 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $164,839,000 after purchasing an additional 122,762 shares during the period. Security National Bank of Sioux City Iowa IA grew its holdings in shares of Apple by 10.0% in the first quarter. Security National Bank of Sioux City Iowa IA now owns 13,327 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,915,000 after purchasing an additional 1,210 shares during the period. Finally, Aristotle Capital Management LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the first quarter valued at about $575,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 60.19% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) traded down $0.37 during trading hours on Wednesday, hitting $175.82. The stock had a trading volume of 4,440,000 shares, compared to its average volume of 25,740,000. The company has a quick ratio of 1.23, a current ratio of 1.28 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $118.22 and a 1-year high of $179.39. The stock has a market cap of $902,740.00, a PE ratio of 19.13, a P/E/G ratio of 1.45 and a beta of 1.23. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. The firm had revenue of $52.58 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $50.71 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 36.29% and a net margin of 21.09%. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.2% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business earned $1.50 EPS. research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.18 EPS for the current year. 
Several brokerages have weighed in on AAPL. ValuEngine raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Sunday, December 31st. Piper Jaffray Companies reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 2nd. BMO Capital Markets reissued a “buy” rating and set a $199.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 20th. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, December 26th. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co restated a “market perform” rating and set a $195.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, November 14th. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, ten have issued a hold rating, thirty-nine have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $198.94. 
In other Apple news, SVP Johny Srouji sold 5,760 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, November 22nd. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.40, for a total value of $1,004,544.00. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now directly owns 81,560 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $14,224,064. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, December 7th. The shares were sold at an average price of $169.69, for a total value of $2,654,121.29. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 17,341 shares in the company, valued at $2,942,594.29. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last ninety days, insiders sold 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders. Apple Profile

The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
